findings.message: This loop appears to issue a database call on every iteration (N+1 query pattern). Each iteration adds its own round-trip cost and carbon overhead; batch it into a single query (e.g. Django's prefetch_related/select_related, or an equivalent bulk fetch/IN query) before the loop instead.
